description: This class provides REST endpoints for uploading and downloading files within a Spring Boot application. It interacts with a FileStorageService to handle file persistence and retrieval.

classes.name: FileController
classes.description: REST controller for file upload and download functionalities.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading a file, stores it, and returns filename and path.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Handles downloading a file by filename, returning the file as a resource.
